item.title: At least 11 Christians killed on their way to Christmas celebrations in Sudan, sources say
item.description: A Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) drone strike on Dec. 25 killed at least 11 Christians on their way to Christmas celebrations in South Kordofan state, Sudan, sources said. #Sudan #Africa #Christian #Christmas

item.title: Court dismisses lawsuit seeking to nullify election of pastor of historic Abyssinian Baptist Church
item.description: New York Supreme Court Judge James G. Clynes has dismissed a lawsuit mounted by four current and former members of the historic Abyssinian Baptist Church that sought to nullify the recent election of the Rev. Kevin R. Johnson as the new pastor of the 200-year-old congregation. #NewYorkStateSupremeCourt #JudgeJamesGClynes #AbyssinianBaptistChurch #KevinRJohnson #Lawsuit

item.title: Porn star Lily Phillips gets baptized; questions about her sincerity emerge
item.description: Porn star Lily Phillips says she has been rebaptized and is re-embracing the Christian faith, prompting a debate about whether the development is sincere or merely a publicity stunt. #LilyPhillips #OnlyFans #Instagram #RussellBrand #JonRoot #Porn #Baptism #Conversion

item.title: Members of Congress spar over Trump’s capture of Maduro: ‘Reckless’ or protecting Americans?
item.description: As debate intensifies over the legality and consequences of President Donald Trump’s military operation in Venezuela, members of Congress are sharply divided. The overnight capture of Nicolás Maduro has triggered partisan reactions that reflect longstanding disputes over presidential war powers, foreign intervention and congressional oversight. #PresidentTrump #MilitaryOperationinVenezuela #USCongress #Republicans #Democtats #CaptureofMaduro #PresidentialWarPowers #ForeignIntervention #Congressi

item.title: Pastor with previous charges for violence fatally shot in domestic incident
item.description: A 31-year-old Alabama pastor was shot in a domestic incident and died at a local hospital days later. The victim, identified as Da’Quarius Green, had previously faced domestic violence charges, though the cases were dismissed. #PastorShot #DomesticViolence #Alabama #ElbaZionMissionaryBaptistChurch

item.title: Trump's capture of Maduro sparks predictable split among world leaders
item.description: As the U.N. Security Council prepares to meet Monday for an emergency session to discuss the U.S. strike on Venezuela that led to the capture of dictator Nicolás Maduro, world leaders are sharply divided over the legality and consequences of the operation. Here are seven responses that reflect that divide. #Trump #Maduro #UNSecurityCouncil #AntnioGuterres #MarcoRubio #JuanGuaid #KeirStarmer

item.title: Outgoing megachurch Pastor Jon Weece launches new ministry to feed deer jerky to hungry children
item.description: A year after announcing he would step down as senior pastor of Southland Christian Church, Pastor Jon Weece preached his final message Sunday and revealed the launch of a new ministry called Boone Brothers that will feed deer jerky to hungry children. #JonWeece #DeerJerky #SouthlandChristianChurch

item.title: 4 potential targets for Trump after Maduro's capture
item.description: Following the U.S. military operation that captured Venezuelan leader Nicolás Maduro and his wife, President Donald Trump and his administration have hinted that there could be similar operations in other countries. #Venezuela #PresidentDonaldTrump #NicolasMaduro #Cuba

item.title: Incoming archbishop of Canterbury speaks out against assisted suicide: We need better care, not killing
item.description: The incoming archbishop of Canterbury has spoken out against assisted suicide, as a bill to legalize helping people end their lives is moving through the U.K. Parliament. #SarahMullally #ChurchofEngland #Euthanasia #TheresaMay #UnitedKingdom

item.title: Gov. Tim Walz won't seek reelection: No time to campaign, I must defend Minnesota against criminals
item.description: Former Democrat vice presidential hopeful Tim Walz will not seek a third term as governor of Minnesota, amid the ongoing Somali immigrant daycare scandal. #TimWalz #election #daycare #fraud #Minnesota #Somalis #immigrants #scandal #Trump
